column1: # ZAP baseline rule decisions (tab-separated: id, IGNORE/INFO/WARN/FAIL, reason). Unlisted rules: WARN.

column3: Strict-Transport-Security missing or disabled (scripts/zap-baseline.sh: INFO on localhost, where HSTS_MAX_AGE=0 on purpose)
Sensitive information in URL (forms with credentials or personal data use method="post")

CSP script-src 'unsafe-inline': accepted. Next.js inlines its bootstrap scripts; nonces would make every page dynamic (packages/ui/src/security-headers.ts). No user HTML is rendered (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML)
COEP / CORP: COEP require-corp would block Turnstile and map tiles; the API sends CORP same-site on purpose (the website on the sibling host reads it)
Cache-control: pages are public; the API sends no-store
Non-storable content: intended (no-store on the API)
No anti-CSRF token in forms: they never post to a server (JavaScript calls the API, which checks Origin / Referer: app/security.py)
